# <%= current_page.data.title %>

This is the canonical structure for a page on this site. The `docs-site` skill copies
it, so if you change the shape of your pages, change it here and the skill follows.

Sections below are a starting point — keep the ones that earn their place and delete
the rest. A page padded with empty headings is worse than a short one.

## Purpose

What this page covers, and who it is for. One short paragraph.

## Overview

The context a reader needs before the detail: what the thing is, where it sits,
what depends on it.

## Detail

The substance of the page. Use subheadings, tables and code blocks freely.

| Item | Description |
|---|---|
| \<item\> | \<description\> |

## Related pages

Link to the built page name, not the source filename — `[Error codes](error-codes.html)`,
not `error-codes.html.md.erb`.

- \<Page title\> — \<why a reader would go there\>
